target: obs.sh context — AGENTIC_PHASE/AGENTIC_SPEC_ID env beats the context file
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" context set --phase build --spec-id file.md; AGENTIC_PHASE=headless AGENTIC_SPEC_ID=env.md "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" emit probe '{}'; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
